profile.name: Hoang Kim
profile.summary: Hi, I'm Kim. I am a Frontend Developer specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript and TailwindCSS. I have experience building scalable web applications and working with real world systems across different domains. Currently, I work as a developer at Mai Tech and also take on freelance projects, developing and maintaining modern web applications.

experienceItems.description: Built the front-end for Grandix, a One Piece TCG price-tracking platform, using TanStack Start (React 19, Vite) and Tailwind CSS v4: card search, price-history charts, portfolio tracking, and a market overview. Also worked on healthcare-related features for Ngoc Minh Clinic, including a Node.js-based tool to convert patient files and X-ray images into PDFs for UI display.

Developed education management systems for English centers such as TalkFirst and IELTS City. Built admin platforms for managing center operations, course payments, students, teachers, and class schedules, as well as student and teacher portals for schedules, attendance, classroom evaluation, and LMS learning activity workflows.

projectItems.title: Grandix
projectItems.description: A One Piece TCG price-tracking platform. Built the front-end with TanStack Start (React 19, Vite) and Tailwind CSS v4: card search, price-history charts, portfolio tracking, and a market overview (top gainers/losers). Created reusable, responsive UI components and worked on the data layer with Supabase/PostgreSQL, including server-side price scraping.

projectItems.title: Ngoc Minh Healthcare Project
projectItems.description: A healthcare support tool that converts patient information files, X ray images, and related medical documents into PDF files for easier display on the user interface. Built a NodeJS based file processing tool and supported processed file preparation for more efficient UI display.

projectItems.title: Smart Campus – Admin Portal
projectItems.description: An English center management system built for TalkFirst and IELTS City. Developed admin screens with Next.js 15, Material UI v6, and Zustand: student management, courses and payments, class scheduling (calendar UI), attendance, and teacher profiles. Analysed business flows with the center and wrote specs for the back-end team, then implemented the matching UI. Technology: Next.js, NestJS, TailwindCSS, Material UI. Team: 3 members.

projectItems.title: Smart Campus – LMS Platform
projectItems.description: An IELTS practice and grading system for TalkFirst and IELTS City. Built the front-end with Next.js 15 and Shadcn/ui for five user roles (student, teacher, QC, academic, operations): test simulation, rubric scoring, and bulk CSV import. Mapped requirements into user flows and data models and coordinated API design with the NestJS back-end team. Technology: Next.js, Shadcn/ui, NestJS. Team: 3 members.
